B62C.ja: 畜力牽引運搬車注．このサブクラスは運搬車及びその部分が畜力牽引運搬車に関連した特徴をもつ限りにおいてのみ包含する；　もしそのような特徴が無ければ，畜力牽引運搬車は　Ｂ６２Ｄ又はＢ６０で取り扱われるトレーラ又はＢ６２Ｂで取り扱われるそりと見なす。
B62C.en:
VEHICLES DRAWN BY ANIMALS

NOTE

This subclass covers only vehicles or parts thereof in so far as the relevant features are essential for animal-drawn vehicles.
This subclass does not cover animal-drawn vehicles which have not the features mentioned in Note (1) above. They are regarded as trailers which are covered by class B60 or subclass B62D, or as sledges which are covered by subclass B62B.

WARNING

In this subclass non-limiting references (in the sense of paragraph 39 of the Guide to the IPC) may still be displayed in the scheme.

B62.en: LAND VEHICLES FOR TRAVELLING OTHERWISE THAN ON RAILS

B.en:
PERFORMING OPERATIONS; TRANSPORTING

NOTE

The following notes are meant to assist in the use of classes B01 - B09; they must not be read as modifying in any way the elaborations.
In this sub-section, the separation of different materials, e.g. of different matter, size, or state, is predominantly found in the following subclasses:
B01D
B03B, B03C, B03D
B04B, B04C
B07B, B07C
The classifying characteristics of these subclasses are:
the physical state of the matter to be separated
the principle of the process used
particular kinds of apparatus The first of these characteristics involves six different aspects, assembled in three groups.
liquid/liquid or liquid/gas and gas/gas
solid/liquid or solid/gas
solid/solid
Theses subclasses are to be used according to the following general rules:
B01D is the most general class as far as separation other than solids from solids is concerned.
Apparatus for separating solids from solids are covered by B03B when the process concerned is regarded as the equivalent of "washing" in the sense of the mining art, even if such apparatus is a pneumatic one, especially pneumatic tables or jigs. Screens PER SE are not covered by this subclass but are classified in B07B, even if they are being used in a wet process. All other apparatus for the separation of solids from solids according to dry methods are classified in B07B.
If the separation takes place as a result of the detection or measurement of some feature of the material or articles to be sorted it is classified in B07C.
It should also be noted that the separation of isotopes of the same chemical element is covered by B01D59/00, whatever process or apparatus is employed.

B62C1/06.ja: 変換可能なもの，例．伸張自在な部分をもつものまたは車輪間隔を変えられるもの
B62C1/06.en: convertible, e.g. with extensible parts, with changeable wheel track

B62C1/08.ja: レース用運搬車，例．一人乗一頭立て二輪馬車

B62C3/00.ja: 運搬車の下部構造または走行装置；車軸支持（農機具または装置を支持する下部構造　Ａ０１Ｂ３５／３０，Ａ０１Ｂ３９／２４；５Ａ０１Ｂ５１／００）
B62C3/00.en: Undercarriages or running gear of vehicles; Axle supports (undercarriages for supporting agricultural tools or apparatus A01B35/30, A01B39/24, A01B51/00)

B62C3/02.ja: 前輪荷台；ボギー；操向機構
B62C3/02.en: Front wheel carriers; Bogies; Steering mechanisms for bogies

B62C5/00.ja: 牽引装置の組立体（牽引ばん馬具Ｂ６８Ｂ３／００）

B62C5/02.ja: 柄，轅，またはかじ棒；それの取付け，例．弾性のあるものまたは調節可能なもの
B62C5/02.en: Shafts, poles, or thills; Mountings thereof, e.g. resilient, adjustable

B62C5/04.ja: 振り棒；その取付け；牽引する動物間隔を等しく牽引するもの；引き革の取付け（引き革Ｂ６８Ｂ３／２０）

B62C7/00.ja: 畜力牽引運搬車独特の制動機構と制動制御装置　（制動一般Ｆ１６Ｄ）
B62C7/00.en: Braking mechanisms and brake control devices specially adapted for animal-drawn vehicles (brakes in general F16D)

B62C7/02.ja: 路面走行車輪を鎖錠するための機構，例．スポークに結合するもの
B62C7/02.en: Mechanisms for locking ground-engaging wheels, e.g. engaging spokes

B62C9/00.ja: 鞭携帯具または保持具；運搬車に取付けるかまたは運搬車の一部分として形成している手綱保持具（鞭または手綱それ自体Ｂ６８Ｂ）
B62C9/00.en: Carriers or holders for whips; Holders for reins forming part of or attached to vehicles (reins or whips per seB68B)

B62C11/00.ja: 他に分類されない安全保護装置，例．取扱い難い牽引用動物を簡単に解放できるようなもの
B62C11/00.en: Safeguarding appliances not otherwise provided for, e.g. for readily releasing unmanageable draught animals

B62C11/02.ja: 離脱可能なかじ棒を用意しているもの

B62C11/04.ja: 自動制動装置に結合されているもの

B62C99/00.en: Subject matter not provided for in other groups of this subclass
